title: Kashiwara Algebras and Imaginary Verma Modules for $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak{g}})$
abstract: We consider imaginary Verma modules for quantum affine algebra $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak{g}})$, where $\hat{\mathfrak{g}}$ is of type 1 i.e. of non-twisted type, and construct Kashiwara type operators and the Kashiwara algebra $\mathcal K_q$. We show that a certain quotient $\mathcal N_q^-$ of $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak{g}})$ is a simple $\mathcal K_q$-module.

cards.label: Corollary 5
cards.snippet: [CFK2] $M_q^r(\lambda)$ is free as a module over $U_q(-S)$.

cards.label: Corollary 7
cards.snippet: $M^d_q(\lambda)$ is irreducible if and only if $\lambda(c)\neq 0$.

cards.label: Theorem 8
cards.snippet: Let $\lambda\in P$ such that $\lambda(c)=0$. Then module $\tilde{M}_q(\lambda)$ is simple if and only if $\lambda(h_i)\neq 0$ for all $i\in \dot I$.

cards.label: Lemma 12
cards.snippet: $\mathcal N_q^-$ is a left $\mathcal K_q$-module and $$\mathcal N_q^-\cong \mathcal K_q/\sum_{i=1}^N\sum_{k\in\mathbb Z}\mathcal K_q\Omega_{\psi_i}(k).$$

cards.label: Proposition 13
cards.snippet: There is a unique symmetric form $(\enspace, \enspace)$ defined on $\mathcal N^-_q$ satisfying $$ (x^-_{i,m}a,b)=(a,\Omega_{\psi_i}(-m)b),\quad (1,1)=1. $$

cards.label: Lemma 14
cards.snippet: Let $P\in \mathcal N_q^-$. If $\Omega_{\psi_i}(s)P=0$ for all $s\in \mathbb Z$ and all $1\leq i\leq N$, then $P$ is a constant multiple of $1$.
